description: Every normalized BlackEcho record carries this envelope. Observed facts and inferred relationships are explicitly distinct.

id.description: Stable deterministic ID, e.g. be:finding:<sha256 of canonical fields>

evidence_ref.description: ID of the Evidence record this derives from

native_ref.description: Path to retained raw native JSON output

record_kind.description: observed = tool directly saw it; inferred = derived by correlation/scoring

source_tool.description: Tool that produced the native output, e.g. huntforge

source_version.description: Tool version / pinned commit short SHA

title: BlackEcho common record envelope
